dingodirt

Open-source tools for off-road riding.

Nav → Offline GPX track follower. Install it as a PWA and ride with it. Studio → Design map schemes, test-drive them at speed, publish them. Plan → Route planning over the segment network. Needs a backend — see the repo.
These are built from grantpaisley/dingodirt, MIT licensed. The dingodirt.com site is deployed separately — it needs a database and auth, which GitHub Pages can't host.
